description: This file defines structures, types, and function prototypes for the FreeType cache system related to image glyphs, including cache node management and glyph loading functions.

classes.name: FTC_INodeRec_
classes.description: Structure representing a cache node containing a glyph and its associated gnode.

classes.name: FTC_IFamilyClassRec_
classes.description: Class structure for font family cache, including glyph loading function.

methods.name: FTC_INode_New
methods.description: Creates a new cache node and loads a glyph into it.

methods.name: FTC_INode_Weight
methods.description: Calculates the weight of a cache node.
